notes: Values live in Key Vault and are installed by the release operator as 0400 host files; the runtime identity cannot read the vault.
With enable_azure_openai=false, prod has no LLM endpoint until the OpenAI opt-in. Do not point at any shared model account.

With enable_azure_openai=true, set WORKSPACE_LLM_ENDPOINT from the foundation module output azure_openai_endpoint (prod account only), keep model gpt-4.1, and load WORKSPACE_LLM_API_KEY from Key Vault per the secret-loading section. Deployment name created by the module is gpt-4.1-dzus (deployment_created_when_enabled).
REAL_PATIENT_RECORDING_ENABLED stays false in the production hosting profile.
